 HOUSTON, November 17, 2026 --( BUSINESS WIRE )-- SmartVault , the recommended document management partner for Intuit ProConnect, Lacerte, and ProSeries, today announced a major value enhancement to its decade-plus partnership with Intuit. The expanded capabilities extend SmartVault's AI-powered client intake solution, SmartRequestAI®, across both ends of the tax preparation workflow, fully automating the intake, document collection and tax return prep processes for Intuit ProConnect and Intuit Lacerte. 
 The new capabilities enable ProConnect and Lacerte firms using SmartRequestAI to import prior-year client data directly from ProConnect or Lacerte drawing on over 200 structured fields including named income sources, to automatically build each client's custom questionnaire and document request list. As clients complete the questionnaire, SmartRequestAI assembles every answer and uploaded document into a bookmarked, prep-ready workpaper securely stored in SmartVault, organized by request section. Once that workpaper is complete, firms can export it directly back into ProConnect or Lacerte with a single click, populating the corresponding fields in the current-year return eliminating manual data entry. 
 "Our partnership with Intuit continues to add value to tax professionals, giving them more time for the work that actually needs their judgment," said Dania Buchanan, President of SmartVault. "This expansion delivers on that from two directions: it automates the most time-consuming stages of tax prep, and it does that securely within the SmartVault ecosystem, reducing the need for additional 3rd party apps accessing client data. That's less risk for the firm, fewer apps for the preparer to manage, and more time back for the clients who need it." 
 This supported integration builds on a partnership that dates back to 2014, when SmartVault became Intuit's exclusive integrated document management system for Lacerte and ProSeries, and expanded integration support for ProConnect last year. These enhanced capabilities in SmartRequestAI support SmartVault's broader mission to give tax professionals a secure, connected platform for managing client documents through the full tax prep workflow–from proposal and initial intake through to final delivery. 
 Story Continues Key Benefits of SmartRequestAI for ProConnect and Lacerte firms 
 Imports prior-year client data directly from ProConnect or Lacerte, drawing on approximately 200 structured fields including named income sources, to build a custom client questionnaire and document request list 
 Assembles every client answer and uploaded document into a bookmarked, prep-ready workpaper securely stored in the client folder in SmartVault 
 Exports the completed workpaper back into ProConnect or Lacerte with a single click, populating the corresponding fields to create a draft return, ready for review 
 Extends automation across intake, document collection and tax return prep, the most time-consuming stages of the tax workflow 
 Builds on SmartVault's position as Intuit's third-party document management partner integrated with ProConnect, ProSeries, and Lacerte 
 These additional capabilities for ProConnect and Lacerte, embedded directly within SmartVault's SmartRequestAI feature, are expected to be available in Q4 2026, ahead of tax season.

 About SmartVault 
SmartVault is a cloud-based document management, portal and tax automation platform built for accounting and tax professionals. Founded in 2008, SmartVault helps firms streamline workflows, strengthen client collaboration, and maintain top-tier security and compliance. Today, over 30,000 tax, accounting and business professionals trust SmartVault to securely store, manage, and share more than 600 million documents worldwide. The platform integrates with industry leading tax apps including Intuit Lacerte, ProSeries, ProConnect Tax, UltraTax CS, Drake Tax, CCH Axcess Tax, and CCH Prosystem FX, automating client intake, document collection and tax return prep, delivery, and storage in one system. SmartVault is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, helping firms meet IRS 4557, FTC Safeguards Rule, and GLBA requirements.
